top_signals.title: Stained Glass and Sacred Spaces: Symbolism Abounds in Ukrainian Media
top_signals.summary:
Welcome to The Ukraine Compass, a weekly digest of Ukrainian commentary and analysis from across the political spectrum, only for War on the Rocks members. Each week, we bring you a curated selection of articles from Ukrainian media offering insight into how Ukrainians themselves debate the issues shaping their country.Western coverage often narrows the view to the battlefield — these pieces widen it, revealing the texture of daily life, politics, and public argument in a nation at war. The perspectives gathered here are varied, candid, and often surprising, together forming a more complete picture of Ukraine as it really is.Frontline

top_signals.title: Japan’s household spending slumps most since pandemic
top_signals.summary: Outlays by households adjusted for inflation declined 6.8% in September from a year earlier, led by transport, education and entertainment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Australia Probes Bathla as Private Credit Flaws Persist
top_signals.summary: Australia’s corporate regulator has opened an investigation into insolvent Sydney developer Bathla Group as its latest surveillance showed that poor practices persist in the country’s A$250 billion ($172 billion) private credit industry.

top_signals.title: Honey traps: Sex, lies and a spy’s oldest trick
top_signals.summary: History is packed with people who found themselves ensnared by men and women tasked with winning their trust before extracting information.
